title: WsFrame missing Clone derive
description: WsFrame is #[non_exhaustive] and derives PartialEq but not Clone. All three current variants (StateChange, Response, Unknown) contain only Clone types (StateChange: Clone, JmapResponse: Clone, String: Clone). Missing Clone forces callers who want to store, log, or pass a received frame to multiple consumers to resort to Debug output or manual pattern matching and reconstruction. A caller receiving a WsFrame::Response over WebSocket cannot hand it to two consumers without re-parsing the wire data. Adding Clone matches the pattern used by SseFrame, SseEvent, and StateChange (all added in the previous review pass) and is consistent with the crate's design.
